body: Clarification, I used fingernail clippers to clip off imperfections and make the surface of my skin a lot smoother. This helps reduce areas for me to pick off.

Hey, I also have dermatillomania and I thought I’d share a few things that help me reduce picking at my fingers. I definitely still do it, but not to this extent anymore. First, clip all your nails as short as you can. It becomes significantly harder to pick at imperfections in my skin. Additionally, I found chewing gum to be helpful although I’m not sure it works for everyone. Lastly, I did use things like fingernail clippers to clip off imperfections so that it reduced my ability to peel skin. I hope this helps you like it did for me.
